caveats: Baseline years are 1992-2002; per the prescribed method the +/-5 calendar-day day-of-year windows additionally draw on 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05. The requested inclusive bounds fall between grid nodes: the analysed cells are the 60x60 grid cells with centres at latitude 56.14..57.32 N and longitude 17.72..18.90 E. Sea cells = 3300, all-NaN (land) cells = 300. Per-cell MHWs were searched only within 2015-06-01..2015-08-31, so an MHW straddling a window edge would be truncated (not the case here: the single regional event 2015-07-01..2015-07-08 lies inside the window). Per-cell MHWs: 1073; no 1-2-day gap joins were required. All computations in float64; quantile is Hyndman-Fan type 5 (MATLAB default / numpy method='hazen').
